# Biteperk

> Biteperk builds voice and AI tools for Australian hospitality. Our flagship product, VocoTable, is an AI phone host that answers every restaurant call in a warm Australian voice, checks live availability, and books the table 24/7 — so venues never lose a booking to a phone nobody can answer. Built, hosted and supported in Sydney; serving restaurants, cafés and venues Australia-wide.

Biteperk Pty Ltd is based at Level 1, 477 Pitt Street, Haymarket NSW 2000, Australia.
Contact: phone 0450 011 140 (+61 450 011 140), email hello@biteperk.com.au, hours Mon–Fri 9am–5pm AEST.
This site is static HTML with schema.org structured data (Organization + LocalBusiness, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, Product/AggregateOffer, FAQPage, BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList) on every page.

## Products

- [VocoTable](https://biteperk.com.au/products/vocotable/): LIVE. The AI phone host for restaurants — an Australian-voice agent ("Bella") that answers every call on the first ring, 24/7, handles the booking conversation, and writes reservations straight into the venue's diary. Pricing (AUD, flat monthly, no per-call fees): Solo $80/month, Pro $150/month, Group $250/month, Enterprise custom.
- [VocoOrder](https://biteperk.com.au/products/vocoorder/): In development. Phone and takeaway order automation for restaurants.
- [VocoConcierge](https://biteperk.com.au/products/vococoncierge/): In development. AI guest concierge that handles enquiries (hours, location, FAQs) by voice and SMS.
- [VocoDrive](https://biteperk.com.au/products/vocodrive/): Concept. AI order-taking for drive-through and quick-service venues.
- [All products](https://biteperk.com.au/products/): The full Biteperk product catalogue with current status of each.

## Guides (blog)

- [What missed phone calls really cost your restaurant](https://biteperk.com.au/blog/what-missed-calls-cost-your-restaurant/): A simple way to put a dollar figure on a restaurant's missed calls, and what to do about it.
- [AI phone answering for Sydney restaurants: a plain-English guide](https://biteperk.com.au/blog/ai-phone-answering-for-sydney-restaurants/): What AI phone answering is, how it works for a Sydney restaurant, what it costs, and how to spot a good one.
- [How to forward your restaurant phone to an AI host](https://biteperk.com.au/blog/how-to-forward-your-restaurant-phone-to-an-ai-host/): Step-by-step call forwarding for restaurants (Telstra, Optus, VoIP) without changing your number.
- [Why an Australian voice matters on your restaurant's phone](https://biteperk.com.au/blog/why-an-australian-voice-matters/): Why a genuinely local voice — accent, place names, data — changes how guests feel about a venue.
- [How much does AI phone answering cost for a restaurant?](https://biteperk.com.au/blog/how-much-does-ai-phone-answering-cost-for-a-restaurant/): Pricing models, the per-call fees to watch for, and how to work out your payback.
- [AI receptionist vs answering service vs voicemail](https://biteperk.com.au/blog/ai-receptionist-vs-answering-service-vs-voicemail/): A clear comparison of the ways restaurants handle phone calls and which fits which venue.
- [How to reduce no-shows at your restaurant](https://biteperk.com.au/blog/how-to-reduce-no-shows-at-your-restaurant/): Tactics that actually reduce no-shows — confirmations, easy rebooking, deposits — and how answering every call helps.
- [Do diners actually want to talk to an AI on the phone?](https://biteperk.com.au/blog/do-diners-want-to-talk-to-an-ai/): What diners really care about on a call, and when a voice agent helps or hurts.
- [All guides](https://biteperk.com.au/blog/): The full Biteperk guides hub for restaurant owners.
